title: Tuning the auxiliary donor in D–D–π–A photosensitizers to enhance DSSC photovoltaic performance: a DFT/TDDFT study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50751-50764
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07959D, Paper
Open Access

Rinki Deka, Bikash Kalita, Dhruba Jyoti Kalita
Through DFT and TD-DFT simulations, we investigate the impact of various auxiliary donors on the geometrical configurations, electronic structures, and optical properties of a series of D–D–π–A architectured dyes.
